23: // LockoutStore provides semantics for account lockout management.
24: type LockoutStore interface {
25: 	// IsLockedOut returns true if the given user has been locked along with the
26: 	// reason.
27: 	IsLockedOut(userID int32) (reason string, locked bool)
28: 	// IncreaseFailedAttempt increases the failed login attempt count by 1.
29: 	IncreaseFailedAttempt(userID int32)
30: 	// Reset clears the failed login attempt count and releases the lockout.
31: 	Reset(userID int32)
32: 	// GenerateUnlockAccountURL creates the URL to unlock account with a signet
33: 	// unlock token.
34: 	GenerateUnlockAccountURL(userID int32) (string, string, error)
35: 	// VerifyUnlockAccountTokenAndReset verifies the provided unlock token is valid.
36: 	VerifyUnlockAccountTokenAndReset(urlToken string) (bool, error)
37: 	// SendUnlockAccountEmail sends an email to the locked account email providing a
38: 	// temporary unlock link.
39: 	SendUnlockAccountEmail(ctx context.Context, userID int32, userEmail string) error
40: 	// Returns true if the unlock account email has already been sent
41: 	UnlockEmailSent(userID int32) bool
42: }

44: type lockoutStore struct {
45: 	failedThreshold int
46: 	lockouts        *rcache.Cache
47: 	failedAttempts  *rcache.Cache
48: 	unlockToken     *rcache.Cache
49: 	unlockEmailSent *rcache.Cache
50: }

52: // NewLockoutStore returns a new LockoutStore with given durations using the
53: // Redis cache.
54: func NewLockoutStore(failedThreshold int, lockoutPeriod, consecutivePeriod time.Duration) LockoutStore {
55: 	return &lockoutStore{
56: 		failedThreshold: failedThreshold,
57: 		lockouts:        rcache.NewWithTTL("account_lockout", int(lockoutPeriod.Seconds())),
58: 		failedAttempts:  rcache.NewWithTTL("account_failed_attempts", int(consecutivePeriod.Seconds())),
59: 		unlockToken:     rcache.NewWithTTL("account_unlock_token", int(lockoutPeriod.Seconds())),
60: 		unlockEmailSent: rcache.NewWithTTL("account_lockout_email_sent", int(lockoutPeriod.Seconds())),
61: 	}
62: }
63: 
64: func key(userID int32) string {
65: 	return strconv.Itoa(int(userID))
66: }
67: 
68: func (s *lockoutStore) IsLockedOut(userID int32) (reason string, locked bool) {
69: 	v, locked := s.lockouts.Get(key(userID))
70: 	return string(v), locked
71: }
72: 
73: func (s *lockoutStore) IncreaseFailedAttempt(userID int32) {
74: 	metricsAccountFailedSignInAttempts.Inc()
75: 
76: 	key := key(userID)
77: 	s.failedAttempts.Increase(key)
78: 
79: 	// Get right after Increase should make the key always exist
80: 	v, _ := s.failedAttempts.Get(key)
81: 	count, _ := strconv.Atoi(string(v))
82: 	if count >= s.failedThreshold {
83: 		metricsAccountLockouts.Inc()
84: 		s.lockouts.Set(key, []byte("too many failed attempts"))
85: 	}
86: }
87: 
88: type unlockAccountClaims struct {
89: 	UserID int32 `json:"user_id"`
90: 	jwt.RegisteredClaims
91: }
92: 
93: func (s *lockoutStore) GenerateUnlockAccountURL(userID int32) (string, string, error) {
94: 	key := key(userID)
95: 	ttl, exists := s.lockouts.KeyTTL(key)
96: 
97: 	if !exists {
98: 		return "", "", errors.Newf("user with id %d is not locked out, cannot generate unlock url")
99: 	}
100: 
101: 	signingKey := conf.SiteConfig().AuthUnlockAccountLinkSigningKey
102: 	if signingKey == "" {
103: 		return "", "", errors.Newf(`signing key not provided, cannot validate JWT on unlock account URL. Please add "auth.unlockAccountLinkSigningKey" to site configuration.`)
104: 	}
105: 
106: 	expiryTime := time.Now().Add(time.Second * time.Duration(ttl))
107: 
108: 	token := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS512, &unlockAccountClaims{
109: 		RegisteredClaims: jwt.RegisteredClaims{
110: 			Issuer:    globals.ExternalURL().String(),
111: 			ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(expiryTime),
112: 			Subject:   strconv.FormatInt(int64(userID), 10),
113: 		},
114: 		UserID: userID,
115: 	})
116: 
117: 	// Sign and get the complete encoded token as a string using the secret
118: 	decodedSigningKey, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(signingKey)
119: 	if err != nil {
120: 		return "", "", err
121: 	}
122: 	tokenString, err := token.SignedString(decodedSigningKey)
123: 	if err != nil {
124: 		return "", "", err
125: 	}
126: 
127: 	s.unlockToken.SetWithTTL(key, []byte(tokenString), ttl)
128: 
129: 	path := fmt.Sprintf("/unlock-account/%s", tokenString)
130: 
131: 	return globals.ExternalURL().ResolveReference(&url.URL{Path: path}).String(), tokenString, nil
132: }
133: 
134: func formatExpiryTime(ttl int) string {
135: 	minutes := ttl / 60
136: 	seconds := ttl
137: 
138: 	if minutes < 1 {
139: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d seconds", seconds)
140: 	}
141: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%d minutes", minutes)
142: }

144: func (s *lockoutStore) SendUnlockAccountEmail(ctx context.Context, userID int32, recipientEmail string) error {
145: 	key := key(userID)
146: 	ttl, exists := s.lockouts.KeyTTL(key)
147: 
148: 	if !exists || s.UnlockEmailSent(userID) {
149: 		return nil
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	unlockUrl, _, err := s.GenerateUnlockAccountURL(userID)
153: 	if err != nil {
154: 		return err
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	emailF := txemail.Send
158: 	if MockSendEmail != nil {
159: 		emailF = MockSendEmail
160: 	}
161: 	err = emailF(ctx, "account_unlock", txemail.Message{
162: 		To:       []string{recipientEmail},
163: 		Template: emailTemplates,
164: 		Data: struct {
165: 			UnlockAccountUrl string
166: 			ExpiryTime       string
167: 		}{
168: 			UnlockAccountUrl: unlockUrl,
169: 			ExpiryTime:       formatExpiryTime(ttl),
170: 		},
171: 	})
172: 	if err == nil {
173: 		s.unlockEmailSent.SetWithTTL(key, []byte("sent"), ttl)
174: 	}
175: 
176: 	return err
177: }
